ns2:course.label: Investments
ns2:course.description: Introduction to investment analysis, including the theory and implementation of portfolio theory; empirical evidence on the performance of financial assets; evaluation of portfolio investment strategies; and the extension of diversification to international markets. Prerequisite: FIN 520; or MBA 505 - Section G (Finance II); or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: FIN 520; or MBA 505 - Section G (Finance II); or consent of instructor.
